final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ID, step1.avg_hgb, step1.avg_hgb - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_hgb > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3) SELECT step3.ID, step3.avg_hgb, step3.diff, step3.avg_hgb - step4.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10
